contract: Document operators need a compact console to upload files, run direct OCR, scan the archive, and inspect a document. Upload and search are the first actions. Target viewports are 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile. The repository has no existing frontend; the design uses local CSS and no browser API secrets.

accessibility.evidence: Forms have associated labels, a skip link is present, and the detail drawer exposes dialog semantics. In headless Chrome, opening a row focused the close button with a visible focus ring; Escape closed the drawer. Reduced-motion CSS disables transitions.

responsive.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures show readable controls and document rows. Chrome reported innerWidth, body.scrollWidth, and documentElement.scrollWidth all at 390px in the mobile view, so no horizontal overflow occurred.

loading.evidence: With a delayed list response, the list showed Loading documents and disabled pagination; see loading.png.

empty.evidence: A migrated empty database showed No documents yet and an upload next step; see desktop.png.

error.evidence: A simulated list failure showed Documents could not load, the failure detail, and Refresh to try again; see error.png.

partial.evidence: With only activity retrieval failing, metadata and versions remained available and the drawer said Activity is temporarily unavailable; see partial.png.

success.evidence: A disposable sample upload appeared in the list and opened a detail drawer with metadata, download, versions, and activity; see desktop-populated.png and detail.png.

permission.evidence: The console returned 401 without credentials and with document API credentials, 200 with separate UI credentials, and 503 when UI login was unconfigured in tests/test_ui.py.
